purpose: Bounded causal bunching-regime remaining-wait screen for Red Winchester. No app/repo/production/watch changes. All families and subgroups prespecified.
priorWork: Old broad stop-flag remaining-time models and additive departure-order/current-anchor binary classifiers were weak or inconsistent. This screen uses current causal route order, compact spacing regimes, equal-origin fitting and prespecified forecast-range subgroups; it does not rerun a best-stop search.
cohort: Exactly original285 focal visits plus already-scored5 laterSep18 visits=290;160 training outcomes beforeSep14,113 Sep14–17,17 Sep18. All later outcomes already inspected. Newly captured afternoon outcomes stay unopened until all coefficients/support rules frozen.
identity: At each forecast origin use latest unconditional anchor from every bus across ALL routes, known atanchor+15s. Exclude currentbus, other route/day, invalid canonical occurrence and physicalanchor age>300s. Select nearest positive forward/backward modulo stop separation; any same-stop anchor makes ordering unknown. Equal nearest-gap ties also unknown. One peer can be ahead and behind but is flagged, not independent fleet evidence.
spacing: Training-only median leg_sec from reached single-hop canonical Red legs with arrival+120s beforeSep14. Sum inter-stop times in forward and backward route order, no future realized peer trajectory and no extrapolated movement. This is a typical inter-stop-travel-time DISTANCE PROXY; it excludes prospective holds and is not actual time headway or arrival prediction.

regimes.co_anchor: another fresh peer has same latest stop anchor, not proof both stopped
regimes.distinct_close_balance: two distinct ordered peers and either close; (backProxy−forwardProxy)/(sum)
regimes.same_peer_close: one bus plays both roles and either close

sensitivity: Apply identical primary coefficients/support rules to anchor+120s inputs, do not refit/select a favorable timing model. Report identity/availability differences.
control: Ten-feature landmark hazard: existing nine elapsed/lap/15minute-clock terms plus elapsed-at-origin/600. Ownlap is fixed atpin and missingness explicit. Fit current-age landmark remaining-time likelihood with L2=4,unpenalized intercept.
support: Each added feature requires nonzero support from>=20 distinct training focalvisits and>=3 training dates. Gate activation only uses supported closeleader/closefollower/coanchor regime indicators; outside it all correction features arezero and forecast exactlymatchescontrol. Unsupported/missing/tied histories remain in every comparison.
fit: Fit control once on preSep14. Fit each added arm as L2=10 regularized correction to fixed control logits; no correction intercept, no search/calibration, features in declared units. Every eligible landmarkorigin has equal likelihood weight. Overlapping residual histories are dependent and long holds contribute more origins: this is NOT one independent likelihood per hold.
forecast: All neighbor/regime features fixed from forecast origin across the residual hazard. Future own elapsed time and deterministic clock advance. This directly learns remaining time conditional on an initial snapshot; it does not assume neighbors physically staystill or use actual later positions.15sec bins,censored exposure beyond1800residualsec, explicit continued tail.
metrics: Full distribution: WIS80,MAE,p90,width,lower10th pinball,early/late missrates andseverity,distinctaffectedvisits,forecastavailability. Primary equal-origin/checkpoint metrics; fixed-age equalvisits plus visit-balanced descriptive totals. Report all arms/regimes/dates and supported/unsupported ownlap, missing/one-peer/co-anchor states.
forecastBands: Prespecified CONTROL-predicted remaining median<=180,180–480,>480sec (<=3,3–8,>8min), not actual outcome bins. Cross with gate/regime support and per-age; do not choose/deploy a favorable band from these reused data.
validation: Input/time hashes; last-all-route identity and future-delete invariance; exact no-gate fallback; ordered finiteCDF includingtail; all valid short/long waits retained. Audit largestregressions, including known64318/65347 and any coanchor cases. No outcome-based exclusion.
runtimeComparator: Retain actual nine-feature runtime current-wait component with160historical fit and true existing marginalfallback, separate from matched landmarkcontrol. Component gains must survive later continuouswarm fullpickup replay before any servingchange.
newAfternoon: Root may capture AFTER PLANfreeze, but builder does not open newoutcomes until all coefficients/support rules are saved. Apply every frozen arm withoutrefit; report as small same-day extension,not independentdayconfirmation.
